kafka_topic.description: The name of the Kafka topic that backs the stream.

key_format.description: The serialization format of the message key in the topic.

key_schema_id.description: The schema ID of the key schema in Schema Registry. The schema is used for schema inference and data serialization.

partitions.description: The number of partitions in the backing topic.

properties.description: Map of string properties to set as the "streamsProperties" parameter when issuing the KSQL statement via REST

query.description: The KSQL SELECT statement which this stream is materialized from. Note that the provider can't read external changes to this attribute.

replicas.description: The number of replicas in the backing topic.

retention_ms.description: The retention specified in milliseconds in the backing topic.

timestamp.description: Sets a column within the stream's schema to be used as the default source of ROWTIME for any downstream queries.

timestamp_format.description: Use with the timestamp property to specify the type and format of the timestamp column. Note that the provider can't read external changes to this attribute.

value_format.description: The serialization format of the message value in the topic.

value_schema_id.description: The schema ID of the value schema in Schema Registry. The schema is used for schema inference and data serialization.
